$comment: SLOP-28 (EXP-1259 D4/D5): THE search list x4, ONE component for every place that searches a list and picks from it: the `#` issue typeahead in every editor and composer, the composer '+' menu's Implement issue and Run action submenus (composer-menu.json), the issue Picker and the global issue search (web Cmd+K dialog, the IDE search, the phones' search tab). Low-level, so it is also the eUI catalog's `SearchList` (packages/exponential-ui, conformance + 4 renderers). Anatomy: an INPUT row (`input.height`, the nav-search glyph, the field, trailing the muted result COUNT once a query is typed) over the hairline, then the ROWS = the Picker rows (no new row type; issue rows = status glyph, mono identifier, title; action rows = icon + name), `row.height` px on a pointer, `row.heightPhone` on phones, the list scrolls with at most `maxVisibleRows` visible and a `fadeHeight` px bottom fade while more rows sit below; the top row is preselected, Up/Down move (no animation), Enter or Tab pick, a hover selects. Results = `useIssueSearchResults` (lib/issue-search.ts: local rank + the server splice) at the DEFAULT limit (ISSUE_SEARCH_DEFAULT_LIMIT): the editors' old 6/8 typeahead caps are gone. THE `#` TYPEAHEAD: typing `#` at the start of the text or after whitespace or `(` opens the list anchored at the caret (pointer: a popover `popoverWidth` wide; phones: a bottom sheet over the keyboard) with ITS input focused and prefilled with the token typed after the `#` (`typeaheadPrefill`), spaces allowed in the input; a pick replaces `#token` in the editor with `#IDENT ` and returns focus to the editor after it; Escape closes and returns focus leaving the editor text as typed; Backspace in an EMPTY input closes the list and deletes the `#` (deleting `#` closes it). The issue picker and the global search use the same component with their own input placeholder (ISSUE_SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER). Review #5 (2026-10-12): a `#` at the START of a line (in markdown editors AND the composer) opens the search only once a token character follows it (`#E` opens with `E`), so `# Title` and `## H` stay headings; anywhere else `#` opens it at once. The token is `[A-Za-z0-9-]*` only (punctuation ends it). Backspace in the EMPTY input deletes the `#` and the query typed so far (`1 + query.length` from the recorded start); a pick replaces exactly `[start, start + 1 + query.length)` as recorded when the list opened, never text after the caret. TEAM SCOPE (#EXP-1382, owner 2026-10-24): the global issue search searches the ACTIVE team only ×4 (web: the route's team; the IDE: the active team of the window; phones: the shell's one active team, chats.json): the local rank reads only that team's issues and the server splice is ONE request scoped to that team (`teamId`); switching the team re-runs the query. Its empty-query hint says so: ISSUE_SEARCH_EMPTY_HINT `Search issues across this team's boards.` (drift-gated, issue-search-surfaces.test.ts). TYPING never waits on the rank: the input paints every keystroke at once; the rank runs off the UI thread (web: a deferred value; iOS: a debounced task off the main actor whose results are state, never computed in a view body; Android: a flow on Dispatchers.Default) over rows whose timestamps are parsed once per row (cached across keystrokes), never per keystroke.

typeaheadPrefill.name: a bare hash opens with an empty input
the token after the hash prefills the input
an identifier token keeps its dash
a hash inside a word is not a trigger
whitespace between the hash and the caret ends the token
a bare hash at the start of the text waits for a token
a hash at the start of a line opens once a token character follows
a markdown heading never opens the search
a second hash keeps a heading
a bare hash at the start of a later line waits too
a later line's hash opens with its token
